summary: Most of the saved local resource reservation slice is implemented and validated: dind_slots is persisted and migrated, active reservation summaries expose it, metrics/API/console capacity payloads include disk and DinD pressure, terminal release is idempotent, auto-profile DinD reconciliation exists, overlap remains advisory, and ruff, mypy, focused resource/scheduler/status/API/provisioner tests, plus console lint/typecheck/build, passed. One planned queue-admission behavior is still missing.
gaps: QueueDecision.resource_summary does not record a truthful active capacity snapshot: ResourceReservationPlan.summary computes capacity from only the new workspace request, ignoring already-active latest reservations, so available capacity and pressure_reasons in admission records can be wrong when existing CPU, memory, disk, or DinD reservations consume capacity. Add a focused regression with multiple active reservations before create_v2, then compute the queue summary from active totals plus the new request.
